description.value: This spell deals 10 points of shadow damage per caster level (to a maximum of 150 points at 15th level) to all creatures within a 30 feet radius. Additionally, all affected undead creatures heal for that much instead and gain +2 bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and Will saving throws.
